main_text.p: הוּךְ Chald. Proficisci, Ire: Inf. לְמֵהְךָ Ad proficiscendum: Futur. עַד יֵהָךְ Donec iret.
הוּם Divexavit, Turbavit. Niphal נֶהוּם Tumultuari, Turbari. Hiphil, הֵהִים Perstrepuit, Tumultuavit.
מְהוּמָה f. Strepitus, Tumultuatio: plurale, מְהוּמוֹת Vexationes.
הִי Heu, Vae: vel, Planctus, Lamentum.
הוּא הִיא f. Illa, Ista, Ea: plur. הֵנָּה, הֵן.
הָיָה Fuit. Niphal, נִהְיָה Fieri, Effici: item Confici, quasi Defieri dicas, Deficere, Auferri.
אֶהְיֶה Ehje, nomen Dei proprium, Exod. 3.
הִין Hiphil הֵהֵין Paratus fuit, Paratum se obtulit, Voluit.
הִין Hin, mensura in liquidis nomen.
הֵיכָל הִכָל m. Palatium: Templum: plur. הֵיכָלוֹת הַכָּלִים.
הָכַר Obfirmavit se: הַכָּרָה f. Obfirmatio,

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the running head and entries are doubtful at this scan resolution; the page is water-stained along the left edge. Entries are transcribed as far as legible; no [?] marks were added to individual Hebrew forms because the scan does not allow certain reading of the pointing.
